newsitem.title: USA: Delmarva sees 442 MW unit shut 1-2 weeks.
newsitem.headline: Delmarva sees 442 MW unit shut 1-2 weeks.

text.p: Delmarva Power & Light Co expected its 442 megawatt (MW) unit 4 at the Indian River generation facility in Millsboro, Delaware, to remain shut one to two weeks for repairs, the company said Friday.
"We anticipate the unit will be out one to two weeks," said company spokesman Michael Ratchford.
On Tuesday, a malfuntion with the unit's lube oil pump caused a series of vibrations, which in turn, tripped the unit off line.
Ratchford said Indian River 4 was producing electricity at 250 MW before the incident. The unit can burn oil or coal.
Three other units at the Indian River complex, with combined capacity of 340 MW, were unaffected by the events in unit 4, Ratchford said.
Despite the outage, the utility had no trouble meeting power demand on its system, he said.
The Indian River facility is operated and wholly-owned by Delmarva.
